prompt: This repository (invoice-sender) has a background worker that goes to production next month. docs/READINESS.md is the checklist it must meet first: configuration read and checked at start, no secret in the source, structured logs, metrics and health, a bounded graceful shutdown, and a runbook. Change src/ so every item holds, with the interface the checklist gives, and write docs/RUNBOOK.md with the alarms and the monthly cost. Keep `createQueue` as it is and add no dependencies. Do not edit the existing tests under test/ or docs/READINESS.md. Add tests for the checklist in a new file under test/ and make sure `node --test` passes. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The final message reports that the test suite was run and its result, and the new tests cover a refused setting, a failed job's log entry and a shutdown that times out.
The existing tests, docs/READINESS.md and package.json are unchanged, createQueue is unchanged and no dependency was added.
Changes are limited to the checklist; the runbook's alarms name metrics the code emits and the cost follows from the stated volume and price (600 USD a month).
